beats.body: You know which patients need a closer check.

beats.body: Rosa checks the patient before starting care.

beats.body: A clear note helps the next nurse understand the change.

beats.staging: From station open end, Rosa sets a closed chart on work surface, three-quarter standing view
beats.title: Keep records private.
beats.body: Open records only when needed for your care duties.

beats.staging: Rosa pauses by a closed patient door, one hand near torso, attentive listening posture; soft ceiling light only

beats.body: Rosa asks you to stay alert for changes.

beats.body: A patient’s breathing has suddenly become difficult.

beats.staging: Rosa beside a screen at station far end, neutral head upright; view toward lake through left window
beats.title: Ask when unsure.
beats.body: Rosa gives you an instruction you do not understand.
